title_en: Line 10 at Eight in the Morning
note_en: The idiom 一窝蜂, literally "one swarm of bees," describes people all rushing in the same direction at once: 人群就一窝蜂地往前挤 "the crowd swarms forward all at once." It's usually followed by 地 and a verb of movement, so it works like an adverb of manner.
